def is_golomb(marks):
    n = len(marks)
    dists = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            d = marks[j] - marks[i]
            if d in dists:
                return False
            dists.add(d)
    return True

def verify_golomb(marks):
    n = len(marks)
    dists = {}
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            d = marks[j] - marks[i]
            if d in dists:
                print(f"Duplicate distance {d}: ({dists[d][0]},{dists[d][1]}) and ({i},{j})")
                return False
            dists[d] = (i, j)
    print(f"All {len(dists)} distances are unique")
    print(f"Distances: {sorted(dists.keys())}")
    return True
